package.title: Jump Halfway To A Random Corner 1,000,000 Times
alt_titles: Pure Randomness Draws A Perfect Triangle
description: The chaos game: start on a corner of a triangle. Pick a corner at random and jump halfway to it. Repeat.
The jumps are random, but after about a million of them a perfect Sierpinski triangle appears, the same shape at every scale.
4 corners, never the same one twice → a square fractal
6 corners plus the centre, jump 2/3 → a snowflake
Every dot here is a real jump, and every early pluck is one landing.
package.question: Did you expect a triangle? 👇
package.pinned: The chaos game (Michael Barnsley, 1988): random choices, deterministic shape. Every dot is a real jump 🔺
